## Description {#description}

Contains information about existing projections in all tables.

## Columns {#columns}

<!--AUTOGENERATED_START-->
- `database` ([String](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Database name.
- `table` ([String](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Table name.
- `name` ([String](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Projection name.
- `type` ([Enum8('Normal' = 0, 'Aggregate' = 1)](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Projection type.
- `sorting_key` ([Array(String)](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Projection sorting key.
- `query` ([String](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Projection query.
- `settings` ([Map(String, String)](../../sql-reference/data-types/)) — Projection settings.
<!--AUTOGENERATED_END-->

## Example {#example}

```sql
SELECT * FROM system.projections LIMIT 2 FORMAT Vertical;
```

```text
Row 1:
──────
database:    default
table:       landing
name:        improved_sorting_key
type:        Normal
sorting_key: ['user_id','date']
query:       SELECT * ORDER BY user_id, date
settings:     {}

Row 2:
──────
database:    default
table:       landing
name:        agg_no_key
type:        Aggregate
sorting_key: []
query:       SELECT count()
settings:     {}
```
